zh: 董事会要求 AI 转型但缺乏清晰路径
技术投资回报难以量化
竞争对手已开始部署 AI
组织文化不适应快速技术变革
en: Board demands AI transformation without clear path
Hard to quantify tech investment returns
Org culture not adapted to rapid tech change

desc.zh: 半天高管工作坊，对齐 AI 愿景与业务战略
desc.en: Half-day executive workshop aligning AI vision with business strategy

desc.zh: 识别并量化前 10 个高价值 AI 用例及其投资回报
desc.en: Identify and quantify top 10 high-value AI use cases with ROI

desc.zh: 选取 2–3 个标志性用例，以原型验证价值
desc.en: Select 2–3 flagship use cases, validate value with prototypes

desc.zh: 包含商业案例、风险框架和实施路线图的董事会报告
desc.en: Board report with business case, risk framework, and implementation roadmap

zh: AI 投资回报率清晰量化
首批 AI 用例 12 周内上线
董事会信心显著提升
en: First AI use cases live in 12 weeks

zh: 遗留系统拖累交付速度
团队被运维工作淹没
技术债务持续累积
难以招聘和留住顶尖工程人才
en: Hard to attract and retain top engineering talent

desc.zh: 全面评估现有技术栈、债务分布和现代化机会
desc.en: Comprehensive assessment of current stack, debt distribution, and modernization opportunities

desc.zh: 设计自服务开发者平台，建立黄金路径
desc.en: Design self-service developer platform with golden paths

desc.zh: 以绞杀者模式逐步迁移关键模块，零停机
desc.en: Progressively migrate critical modules with strangler-fig pattern, zero downtime

desc.zh: 建立量化的开发者体验指标和持续改进机制
desc.en: Establish quantified DevEx metrics and continuous improvement

zh: 部署频率提升 5–10 倍
变更失败率降至 5% 以下
开发者净推荐值提升 30 分
IT 预算增速赶不上业务需求
多供应商管理复杂度高
数字化转型项目延期普遍
IT 与业务部门缺乏共同语言
en: IT budget growth cannot keep pace with business demand
IT and business lack common language

desc.zh: 将 IT 投资组合与业务战略对齐，识别低价值支出
desc.en: Align IT portfolio with business strategy, identify low-value spend

desc.zh: 优化供应商格局，减少碎片化并提升议价能力
desc.en: Optimize vendor landscape, reduce fragmentation and improve leverage

desc.zh: 从传统 PMO 转向价值流导向的敏捷交付办公室
desc.en: Transform traditional PMO to value-stream-oriented agile delivery office

desc.zh: 建立以产品为单位的 TCO 模型和 FinOps 实践
desc.en: Establish product-level TCO model and FinOps practices

zh: IT 支出效率提升 20–30%
项目按时交付率从 60% 提升至 90%
业务满意度评分提升
运营流程碎片化且依赖人工
供应链可见性不足
跨部门协作效率低下
运营数据未能驱动决策
en: Fragmented operations relying on manual processes

desc.zh: 绘制端到端价值流图，识别自动化与优化机会
desc.en: Map end-to-end value streams, identify automation and optimization opportunities

desc.zh: 在关键流程中部署 RPA、AI 决策辅助和数字孪生
desc.en: Deploy RPA, AI decision support, and digital twins in critical processes

desc.zh: 构建实时运营仪表板，提供端到端可视性
desc.en: Build real-time operations dashboard with end-to-end visibility

desc.zh: 建立 AI 驱动的持续改进闭环
desc.en: Establish AI-driven continuous improvement loop

zh: 运营成本降低 20–35%
端到端流程周期缩短 40%
运营异常响应时间缩短 80%
技术投资回报难以量化和追踪
AI/云支出增长失控
并购中技术风险评估不足
合规与 ESG 报告负担加重
en: Hard to quantify and track tech investment returns
Inadequate tech risk assessment in M&A
Compliance and ESG reporting burden increasing

desc.zh: 审计当前技术支出组合，识别浪费与优化机会
desc.en: Audit current tech spend portfolio, identify waste and optimization

desc.zh: 建立云与 AI 支出的实时可视、预算控制和优化机制
desc.en: Establish real-time visibility, budget control, and optimization for cloud & AI spend

desc.zh: 将 AI 资产、技术债务和网络安全纳入并购尽调
desc.en: Incorporate AI assets, technical debt, and cybersecurity into M&A due diligence

desc.zh: 自动化 IT 碳排放追踪和 ESG 合规报告
desc.en: Automate IT carbon tracking and ESG compliance reporting

zh: 云/AI 支出可见性达到 100%
技术支出浪费减少 25–40%
并购后 IT 整合成本降低 30%
AI 技能缺口巨大
技术人才市场竞争激烈
传统绩效管理不适应敏捷团队
员工对 AI 的焦虑影响士气
en: Traditional performance management doesn't fit agile teams

desc.zh: 评估组织当前的 AI 和数字化技能基线
desc.en: Assess current AI and digital skills baseline across the organization

desc.zh: 制定 build/buy/borrow 人才策略和 EVP 刷新
desc.en: Define build/buy/borrow talent strategy and EVP refresh

desc.zh: 构建 AI 技能提升计划和学习平台
desc.en: Build AI upskilling program and learning platform

desc.zh: 设计并执行 AI 文化变革和员工沟通计划
desc.en: Design and execute AI culture change and employee communication program

zh: AI 技能覆盖率从 15% 提升至 60%
技术岗位招聘周期缩短 40%
员工 AI 信心指数提升
